doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02

chapter: Florida bands and New Orleans comparison
title: Pictures of the Pensacola band
summary: Billie shows a Pensacola photo with a sax, undertaker drummer and De De on cornet.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yes, so Billy has some pictures here to show us for a minute here. We'll look at them while we have them out.

Now, this one picture here. Yeah, it's made in Florida, my hometown. Billy on piano, and who are the other people? Now, this fella here, his home is in Milton, Florida. That's the sax, Alto Sax, I guess. Yeah, that's Charlie Pipson Sax, a great sax. And this fella over here, the drummer, he's an undertaker, he's a big undertaker in my hometown right now, R.A.D. R.A.D. He's like drums. That's what we had in Pensacola, Florida.
And who's the coronet? Is that D.D.?
